body.title: Route insrc_code_review_step by author
body.summary: The tool keeps its start phase with all of its outcomes: the wait prompt for a stale index, the three routes to a diff review, and its two tool-side errors. At the point where it would hand the controller the judgements prompt it reads the build's author, including on the resumed call. Daemon-authored code gets the judgements prompt as today. Controller-authored or unknown-author code is sent to the daemon code review with the full or degraded mode and a 10 minute wait limit. The judgements phase refuses controller-authored code. The fixtures of the two code-review suites get a BUILD record with a daemon author.
acceptanceChecks: A stale index returns confirm_wait and asks no daemon
A declined wait, a wait that times out and empty grounding each ask the daemon with the degraded mode; fresh grounding with symbols asks with the full mode
A resumed call after confirm_wait on controller-authored code asks the daemon and does not return emit_judgements
An unavailable freshness check and unavailable grounding each return their existing error and ask no daemon; a diff the daemon cannot read is reported as a failed daemon review
With a fake daemon and an injected timer, the tool waits with the 10 minute limit and returns a timeout error past it
Daemon-authored code returns emit_judgements as today, and the judgements phase refuses controller-authored code
The two existing code-review suites pass

tests.name: T10 insrc_code_review_step sends controller-authored and unknown-author code to the daemon; daemon-authored code returns emit_judgements
T17 the start phase keeps every outcome: confirm_wait, the three degraded routes, the full route, the two tool-side errors, the resumed call, and a failed daemon review for an unreadable diff
T11 insrc_code_review_step: daemon unreachable, error frame, older daemon and the 10 minute timeout each return an error and stamp nothing
T12 the judgements phase refuses controller-authored code and stamps nothing
